techParks.name: Manyata Tech Park
techParks.locality: Nagavara (Nagawara), Hebbal Outer Ring Road, north Bengaluru
techParks.developer: Embassy Group / Embassy Office Parks REIT (with MFAR and Karle as co-developers of parcels)
techParks.description: Bengaluru's largest office park and the anchor of the city's northern corridor: about 300 acres at Nagavara on the Hebbal stretch of the Outer Ring Road, operational since 2001, with 12.8 msf completed and 3.1 msf under construction per Embassy Group (press coverage in 2026 puts leasable area near 17 msf across 25+ buildings) and 100,000+ workers from 60+ MNCs. Blocks carry both a letter code and a tree name: L1 Banyan, L2 Willow, L3 Hazel, H2 Mountain Ash, F2 Mahogany, E1 Beech, M2 Madhuvana, M3 (ANZ's built-to-suit), plus Redwood, Silver Oak, Silver Fir, Pine, Cedar, Balsa, Eucalyptus, Mulberry, Ebony, Teak, Poplar, Palm, Aspen, Cypress, Elm, Acacia and Green Heart, and the newer Manyata NXT towers beside the dual-branded Hilton hotels at the south gate. Greenheart Tech Park (~1.5 msf) is a strata-owned parcel inside the campus; MFAR developed another parcel. Anchor occupiers are IBM, Cognizant, Target and Oracle Health (Cerner), with Nokia (511k sq ft), ANZ (618k sq ft, Building M3), Target (831k sq ft from Sep 2025) and Commonwealth Bank of Australia (0.8-1.4 msf built-to-suit due late 2026) the largest recent leases.

techParks.name: Karle Town Centre SEZ
techParks.description: Mixed-use SEZ immediately west of Manyata on the Nagavara side of the Hebbal ORR, developed by Karle Infra with office 'Hubs' (OSM maps Hub 1, 2, 4 and 5, further hubs under construction) alongside the Manpho Convention Centre, Zenith residences and retail. The developer's site was unreachable, so the tenant list rests on OSM POIs.

techParks.name: Kirloskar Business Park
techParks.description: Older low-rise office campus on Bellary Road at Hebbal flyover, redeveloped from the Kirloskar Electric works. OSM records Mahindra Comviva here; the park's own website could not be reached.

techParks.name: Brigade Magnum
techParks.description: Brigade Group office building on Bellary Road at Kodigehalli Gate, Hebbal, next to RMZ Latitude. Tenants are from OSM POIs; Brigade's site returned no project page.

techParks.name: RMZ Latitude
techParks.developer: RMZ Corp (portfolio acquired by Brookfield Properties, 2020)
techParks.description: Mid-size commercial block on Bellary Road at Hebbal, part of the RMZ portfolio Brookfield acquired in 2020 (OSM tags the adjoining 'Azure' building with operator Brookfield Properties). Tenants from OSM POIs.

techParks.name: L&T Tech Park
techParks.description: L&T Realty's SEZ campus on Bellary Road near Byatarayanapura: Phase 1 holds Towers S1 (L&T Technology Services, SEZ Units I-IV) and S2 (LTIMindtree); Phase 2 is under construction to the north per OSM.

techParks.name: Bhartiya Centre of Information Technology
techParks.description: The office component of the 125-acre Bhartiya City township on Thanisandra Main Road, north-east of Manyata: BCIT 1, 2, 3A and 3B are occupied and operational with about 4.1 msf of workspace per the developer, beside The Leela Bhartiya City hotel and Nikoo Homes. The developer's page carries the occupier logos used here.

techParks.description: Three-phase business park at Kogilu Cross on Bellary Road, Yelahanka, on the Hebbal-airport corridor (Phase 1 and 2 operational, Phase 3 under construction per OSM, each with Wings A and B). OSM records RTX's Collins Aerospace and Pratt & Whitney engineering centres, an Infosys office and a WeWork; the developer could not be confirmed.

techParks.developer: Embassy Group / Embassy Office Parks REIT

coverageNotes: Search budget: the shared WebSearch quota was exhausted after six queries, so verification relied on direct fetches of company location pages, Embassy REIT press releases, developer pages and the OSM building/POI layer (which at Manyata is unusually rich: every block is drawn with its tree name). HIGH-confidence Manyata offices rest on company pages (Rolls-Royce L3 Hazel, Lowe's L2 Willow, ANSR L1 Banyan, Voya L3, Availity and Qualitest M2 Madhuvana / H2 Mountain Ash) or on Embassy REIT releases plus OSM (Nokia, ANZ, CBA, Target, IBM, Cerner/Oracle Health, Nvidia, Philips). MEDIUM entries are single-source OSM POIs or developer tenant pages; LOW entries (Microsoft, Harman, Northern Trust, WSP, Citi, Axis Bank, Infosys at North Gate, the second Nokia/Alcatel block, ANSR's NXT floor, Gallagher's second site) are plausible but unconfirmed and are labelled as such. NOT CONFIRMED and therefore LEFT OUT despite being on the lens brief: Colt Technology Services, Microchip Technology, Genpact, Concentrix, Wells Fargo, Mphasis and HCLTech - their location pages were unreachable (403/404/JS-rendered) and no OSM POI, lease report or developer page places them in Manyata or the Hebbal corridor; also 'GE' (named only in a 2025 UrbanVault release, entity unclear), IKEA (one feature article), Justdial, Qualitest's sibling 'iTS', and the defunct Voonik.
